The if_configured attribute is set to True, meaning that users must be verified with an OTP device or be authenticated and not have any confirmed OTP devices to proceed.
predictions.sink_summary: The form_valid method in DeviceCreateView saves the form data and potentially logs in the user with the new OTP device if they are not already verified. This action is a security-sensitive state change that affects user authentication status.
predictions.guard_summary: The OtpRequiredMixin provides guards by checking if the user is verified or if the if_configured flag allows access for users without confirmed devices. The test method in OtpRequiredMixin evaluates whether the user meets the OTP requirement before allowing access to the view.
predictions.risk_pattern: A user can bypass OTP verification if they are authenticated but do not have any confirmed OTP devices, as the if_configured flag is set to True. This allows a user to create a new OTP device without having verified their identity with an existing device.
